items.title: Andrej Karpathy announces he has joined Anthropic — AI talent shockwave
items.summary: Andrej Karpathy, OpenAI founding member and former Tesla AI director, posted a personal update on X saying "I've joined Anthropic." The tweet generated over 11.3M views, 102K likes, and 13K reposts within hours, widely described as the AI talent move of the year. Karpathy will be working on pre-training research at Anthropic.

items.title: OpenAI model disproves 80-year-old Erdős planar unit distance conjecture
items.summary: OpenAI announced that an internal general-purpose reasoning model disproved the Erdős planar unit distance problem, a famous open question in discrete geometry first posed in 1946. The breakthrough demonstrates frontier AI models are advancing beyond IMO gold-level performance toward autonomous mathematical research.

items.title: Sam Altman says kids born today will "never be smarter than AI" — sparks global backlash
items.summary: Sam Altman's prediction that "a kid born today will never be smarter than AI, ever" went massively viral, triggering heated debate across X and news media. Rep. Ro Khanna pushed back on X, saying "My bet is on the kid born today over AI." The quote originally came from a 2025 interview but resurfaced and dominated AI discourse in late May 2026.
